name: IP & Trademark Protection
description: Intellectual property and trademark protection checks — copyright notice, trademark marks, AI training opt-out, IP ownership statements, brand usage guidelines, and infringement reporting contact.

items.description: Copyright notice must be present in page content
items.regulation: Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. §106) / Berne Convention Art. 3
items.remediation: Add a copyright notice footer: '© 2026 Company Name. All rights reserved.'

items.description: Trademark marks (™, ®) or trademark language must be present
items.regulation: Lanham Act (15 U.S.C. §1051) / EU Trade Mark Regulation 2017/1001
items.remediation: Add trademark marks (™ or ®) to brand names and a trademark notice in the footer.

items.description: AI training opt-out must block major crawler bots
items.regulation: Copyright Act §107 (fair use) / EU AI Act Art. 53 / robots.txt convention
items.remediation: Add Disallow directives for GPTBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, and anthropic-ai in robots.txt.

items.description: IP ownership statement must assert intellectual property rights
items.regulation: Best practice — no specific legal requirement but supports enforcement
items.remediation: Include an IP ownership statement in the privacy policy or terms of service.

items.description: Brand usage guidelines or trademark usage policy should be referenced
items.remediation: Include brand usage guidelines or a trademark usage policy section in your legal pages.

items.description: Infringement reporting contact or DMCA takedown notice info must be present
items.regulation: DMCA (17 U.S.C. §512) / EU Copyright Directive 2019/790 Art. 17
items.remediation: Add an infringement reporting contact email and DMCA takedown notice procedure.
